subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

My success was complete and the delighted directors ______ me the privilege of developing automatic regulators which were much desired.
solution: The correct answer is "**accorded**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given words.** • **​contrasted: ** compare in such a way as to emphasize differences. (अंतरों को ज़ोर देकर तुलना करना) • **accorded**: give or grant someone (power, status, or recognition)(किसी को (शक्ति, स्थान या पहचान) देना या अनुदान देना) • **disagreed: ** have or express a different opinion.(अलग मत रखना या व्यक्त करना) • **removed: ** take (something) away or off from the position occupied.((कुछ) किसी स्थान से या ऊपर से हटा देना) • As per the meaning of the given words, "**accorded**" is the appropriate word for the blank. • **Example**: Sachin* was **accorded __**the Padma Vibhushan for his contribution to Indian cricket.* **​The correct sentence is**: *My success was complete and the delighted directors__** accorded**__ me the privilege of developing automatic regulators which were much desired.* Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.** 32:T1015, The correct answer is "**sheer**".
